_status: In production use since 2026-10. Every KPI below is wired to a verified RingCentral data source, and one that cannot be measured carries `blockedBy` explaining why rather than being omitted. Targets are sensible defaults, not contractual ones — set them per engagement. Add KPIs here, never in renderer code.

_sources.ringcxReports: RingCX Reports APIs — require WEM Access
_sources.ringcxRealtime: GET /voice/api/v1/admin/accounts/{acct}/realTimeData/{inbound|outbound|agent|chat|ivr} — ReadAccounts + RingCX reporting rights. NOT WEM. Same-day counters, reset at midnight in the account timezone.

kpis.name: Total calls
kpis.description: All calls RingCentral Business Analytics counted in the window, inbound and outbound. The denominator for volume context, never a score on its own.

kpis.name: Answer rate
kpis.description: Share of answerable inbound calls that reached a person. Answerable means answered + notAnswered; it excludes call legs Analytics does not treat as offered.
kpis.reco: Raise inbound answer rate by closing routing and staffing gaps before adding headcount.
steps: Identify queues with the largest notAnswered share in the Voice report.
Confirm each has members and that overflow/after-hours rules are set.
Check business hours match actual operating hours.
Re-baseline after two weeks and compare the trend.

kpis.name: Missed call rate
kpis.description: Share of answerable inbound calls that went unanswered. The inverse of answer rate, reported separately because it is the figure operations acts on.
kpis.reco: Reduce missed calls — they are the single clearest revenue leak in a voice estate.
steps: Rank queues by notAnswered in the Voice report.
Add members to under-staffed queues or widen overflow targets.
Enable voicemail-to-email so missed calls still reach an owner.

kpis.name: Outbound connect rate
kpis.description: Share of outbound attempts that connected. Measures dialling quality and number reputation, not agent effort.

kpis.name: Average speed to answer
kpis.description: Mean seconds a caller waits before a person answers. Drives abandonment more directly than any other queue metric.
kpis.blockedBy: Not available from RingCentral Business Analytics — it exposes no speed-to-answer timer. The valid timers are allCallsDuration and the callsDurationBy* family (confirmed by ANL-202 from the API). Queue-level speed to answer needs RingCX with WEM.

kpis.name: Average handle time
kpis.description: Mean seconds a connected call lasts. Reference only — a rise can mean either worse efficiency or deeper service.

kpis.name: After-hours call share
kpis.description: Share of calls arriving outside configured business hours. Reveals hours that no longer match how the business operates.

kpis.name: Queues with no members
kpis.description: Call queues with no members assigned. Every call into one is abandoned or misrouted, whatever the staffing level elsewhere.
kpis.reco: Assign members to every queue, or retire the queue.
steps: Open Configuration → Call queues and find rows flagged 'no members'.
Assign at least one member, or delete the queue if it is legacy.
Re-run to confirm the gap closes.

kpis.name: Extensions never activated
kpis.description: Extensions still in NotActivated state. Paid-for seats that no one has ever used.
kpis.reco: Activate, reassign or release never-activated extensions — they are paid-for seats doing nothing.
steps: Export the extension list filtered to NotActivated.
Confirm with the customer whether each is a planned hire or abandoned.
Release the abandoned ones at the next billing cycle.

kpis.name: Disabled extensions
kpis.description: Extensions in Disabled state. Usually leavers — they indicate how quickly offboarding reaches the phone system.
kpis.reco: Release or re-enable disabled extensions so the licence position is accurate.
steps: Review disabled extensions with the account owner.
Release those no longer needed.

kpis.name: License utilization
kpis.description: Active users as a share of licensed seats. The single clearest input to a renewal conversation.
kpis.reco: Keep licence utilisation high — unused seats are pure cost.

kpis.name: Hard phones without E911 address
kpis.description: Hard phones with no emergency service address assigned. Emergency calls from these devices cannot be located — a RAY BAUM'S Act exposure.
kpis.reco: Assign an emergency service address to every hard phone.
steps: List devices with no emergencyServiceAddress.
Set the address for each from its physical location.
Validate against the site record.

kpis.name: Softphone share of devices
kpis.description: Share of devices that are softphones rather than hard phones. Indicates how much desk hardware could be retired rather than refreshed.

kpis.name: Video meetings held
kpis.description: Meetings hosted on RingCentral Video in the window. Shows whether meetings run here or on a parallel tool that is also being paid for.

kpis.name: Video meeting minutes
kpis.description: Total participant minutes on RingCentral Video. Scales meeting adoption by actual time, not meeting count.

kpis.name: SMS volume
kpis.description: Business SMS and MMS messages in the window. Establishes whether the lower-cost channel is being used at all.
kpis.blockedBy: Account-wide SMS volume has no single endpoint — message-store is per extension, so a true total needs one call per extension and does not fit the subrequest budget. A2P campaign health is a separate block: /a2p-sms/* returns 403 InsufficientPermissions without the A2PSMS scope, which this application does not hold.

kpis.name: Calls recorded
kpis.description: Share of calls with a recording. Sets the ceiling on what quality review, coaching and dispute defence can ever cover.
kpis.reco: Confirm recording coverage matches policy — it also gates every AI insight.

kpis.name: AI insight coverage of recordings
kpis.description: Share of sampled recordings that have AI Conversation Expert insights attached. Where coverage is low, quality findings rest on impressions rather than evidence.
kpis.formula: recordings with ACE insights / recordings sampled * 100
kpis.reco: Assign AI Conversation Expert licences so recorded calls generate insights.
steps: Confirm ACE licences are purchased on the account.
Assign a licence to each user whose calls should be analysed.
Confirm those users' calls are being recorded.
Re-run — insights appear only for licensed users' recordings.

kpis.name: Recordings with AI insights
kpis.description: Count of recordings with ACE insights returned. Reference for the coverage figure's denominator.

kpis.name: RingCX queues (gates)
kpis.description: Queues (gates) defined in RingCX, across all gate groups. Reference for the contact-centre configuration findings.
kpis.blockedBy: RingCX Admin permission — the automation user needs MANAGE_USERS or SUPER_USER in the RingCX Admin portal

kpis.name: RingCX agents
kpis.description: Agents defined in RingCX. Reference for agent licence utilisation.
kpis.blockedBy: RingCX Admin permission — MANAGE_USERS or SUPER_USER required

kpis.name: RingCX queue answer rate (today)
kpis.description: Share of presented inbound contacts answered. Available same-day only from realTimeData without WEM, so it describes today, not the measurement window.
kpis.reco: Improve contact-centre answer rate through staffing and routing before adding licences.

kpis.name: Call failure / not-connected rate
kpis.description: Share of outbound attempts that did not connect. Isolates carrier, number and network problems from staffing problems.
kpis.reco: Investigate outbound calls that never connect — a high rate points at number quality or carrier routing.
steps: Segment notConnected by destination and by campaign.
Check for invalid or stale numbers in the dialled lists.
Raise persistent patterns with the carrier.

kpis.name: Active queues
kpis.description: Queues marked active. The denominator for unstaffed-queue findings — inactive gates are excluded so the finding stays true.

kpis.name: Active queues with no agent access
kpis.description: Active queues with no agent holding access. Determined from each gate's assignedAgents endpoint, because the list endpoints return null for agent access.
kpis.reco: Grant agent access to every active queue, or deactivate unused ones.
steps: Open the RingCX report and note queues flagged with no agent access.
In RingCX Admin, assign agents to the gate, or set the gate inactive.

kpis.name: Inactive RingCX agents
kpis.description: Agents marked inactive or never logged in while still holding a seat. Directly reclaimable licence spend.
kpis.reco: Remove or reactivate inactive RingCX agents.

kpis.name: Agents not managed by RingEX
kpis.description: RingCX agents whose identity is not managed by RingEX. Each is a separate joiner-mover-leaver path and a separate offboarding risk.

kpis.name: Dial groups with no campaign
kpis.description: Outbound dial groups with no campaign attached. Outbound capacity configured but not dialling.

kpis.name: RingCX queue abandon rate (today)
kpis.description: Share of presented contacts abandoned before answer. Same-day only from realTimeData without WEM.
kpis.reco: Reduce abandons — callers leaving the queue is the most direct measure of under-staffing.

kpis.name: RingCX outbound answer rate (today)
kpis.description: Share of outbound RingCX attempts answered. Same-day only from realTimeData without WEM.

kpis.name: IVR containment (today)
kpis.description: Share of presented contacts resolved without transfer to a gate. Every contained contact avoids an agent-handled minute. Same-day only.
kpis.reco: Raise IVR containment so fewer callers need an agent.
steps: Review which IVR nodes transfer most often.
Add self-service for the top transfer reasons.
Re-measure containment after each change.

kpis.name: Queue statistics over the measurement window
kpis.description: Queue statistics retrieved over the measurement window from RingCX reporting. Reference for whether window-length queue history is available at all.
kpis.blockedBy: WEM Access not enabled — the HISTORICAL Reports APIs (queue statistics, agent extended statistics, segment metadata) require it. Same-day figures above come from realTimeData and need no WEM.

kpis.name: Extensions offline
kpis.description: Share of user extensions showing Offline presence at the time of the run. A high share means people are not signed in to any RingCentral app, so presence and softphone routing cannot work for them.
kpis.reco: Get the people who are never signed in onto a RingCentral app — presence, softphone and mobility all depend on it.
steps: Export the offline list and compare it against recent call activity.
Separate genuinely unused seats (a licence finding) from users who simply never sign in (a training finding).
Push the desktop and mobile apps through MDM so signing in is the default, not a choice.

kpis.name: Extensions refusing calls via DND
kpis.description: Extensions whose do-not-disturb state is set to refuse all calls or all department (queue) calls. A queue member in this state is counted as staffing but receives nothing, which is invisible from the queue configuration alone.
kpis.reco: Review extensions sitting in a call-refusing DND state, especially any that belong to a call queue.
steps: Cross-reference the DND list against call queue membership.
For queue members, confirm whether the state is deliberate or left on by accident.
Where it is routine, the queue is effectively short-staffed — fix the roster rather than the symptom.

kpis.name: Dedicated fax numbers
kpis.description: Numbers still provisioned for fax. Each one is a displacement target: a recurring cost, and usually a workflow nobody has revisited.
kpis.reco: Identify what still sends and receives fax, and retire the lines whose workflow has an alternative.
steps: Pull fax volume per number for the last quarter.
For numbers with no traffic, release them at the next billing cycle.
For numbers with traffic, find the counterparty — it is usually one partner who can move to secure email or a portal.

kpis.name: Team Chat adoption
kpis.description: Share of users active in Team Chat.
kpis.blockedBy: The Team Messaging API is scoped to the authenticated user — /glip/chats and /glip/teams return only the token owner's own chats and teams, not a tenant-wide view. Account-level chat adoption has no API on this surface; it is available in the RingCentral Analytics portal only.
kpis.reco: Read Team Chat adoption from the RingCentral Analytics portal until an account-level API exists.
steps: Analytics portal → Adoption & Usage → Message, for the measurement window.
Record the figure in the engagement notes rather than the scorecard, so its provenance stays obvious.

kpis.name: Unassigned licenses
kpis.description: Licenses the account holds that are not assigned to anyone. Counted from the platform's own license inventory, which is a different and usually larger figure than dormant extensions — an extension can only be dormant if a licence was assigned to it in the first place.
kpis.reco: Reconcile the unassigned license pool against what the business actually needs before the next renewal.
steps: Take the SKU list from the assessment page to the customer's order form and name each one.
Separate deliberate headroom for planned hiring from licences nobody remembers buying.
Put the remainder on the renewal agenda — this is the single largest reclaimable figure the assessment produces.

_thresholds._note: Rate KPIs are flagged as sample-volume artifacts below EITHER floor. A 90-day window with 3 calls/day is not a basis for a headline rate.

_answerRateNote: Answer rate comes from callsByResponse, NOT callsByResult. On real tenants callsByResult's largest bucket can be 'unknown'. callsByResponse partitions cleanly: answered+notAnswered == inbound, connected+notConnected == outbound.
_blockedByNote: A KPI with `blockedBy` is part of the model but cannot be measured on this tenant yet. It renders as 'not assessed' WITH the reason, never omitted — a layer silently missing from a readout reads as 'assessed and fine'.
_recoNote: reco / steps / lever drive the findings cards and the Increase Your Score panel. Adding guidance is a config edit — never a renderer change.
